hook.h2: You do not have to earn a place in these pages
hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
son: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
hook.note: When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word. Come, hear your Father’s voice.

translationStatement: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from Father's Heart Bible™.

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Sundanese, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Sundanese Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Ieu teh Kitab Suci citakan anu kahiji anu nembongkeun ka anjeun saha anu keur nyarios. Pangandika Rama urang dina warna BIRU, pangandika Putra dina warna BEUREUM, pangandika Roh dina warna UNGU.

Leuwih ti saratus taun aksara beureum geus nembongkeun di mana Putra nyarios. Tapi Rama urang nyarios leuwih loba — dina Kitab Suci basa Sunda ieu 126,058 kecap dina 5,614 ayat. Nepi ka ayeuna kabeh pangandika-Na dicitak ku mangsi hideung anu sarua jeung silsilah-silsilah. Mantenna geus nyarios ti baheula keneh; teu aya Kitab Suci anu kungsi nembongkeun ka anjeun di mana.

Warna teh tanda kapamilikan, lain tanda cutatan. Pangandika Rama urang tetep kagungan-Na dina biwir saha bae anu mawana kalawan satia; kecap anu teu kungsi dipangandikakeun ku Mantenna moal diwarnaan; pangjejer tetep hideung.

Waktu murid-murid-Na naros kumaha cara neneda, Putra lain masihan rumus, tapi masihan hiji Rama: “Nun Ama di sawarga, mugi jenengan Ama disucikeun” (Mateus 6:9). Sagalana dina Kitab Suci ieu lumangsung tina eta hiji kecap. Ku Roh urang sasambat, “Abba! Nun Ama!” (Rum 8:15).

Mantenna lain anu jauh. Mantenna henteu kuciwa ka anjeun. Mantenna teh Rama anjeun nu di sawarga, sarta anjeun teh putra-Na nu dipikaasih. Lamun kecap ‘bapa’ teu ngalilipur pikeun anjeun, Kitab Suci ieu hususna pikeun anjeun: Rama anu ditembongkeun dina kaca-kaca ieu lain kalangkang tina kabapaan manusa anu ruksak; ti Mantenna unggal kulawarga di sawarga jeung di bumi meunang ngaranna.

Kitab Suci lengkep dina hiji jilid — 66 kitab, 1,189 pasal, 31,085 ayat; teu aya anu leungit. Bubuka pikeun unggal kitab, 1,362 catetan pikeun pamaca lain pikeun para ahli, sarta kaca panghaturan pikeun nuliskeun ngaran jalma anu dibere kado ku anjeun.

Tarjamahan anu satia tina basa Ibrani, Aram jeung Yunani aslina; unggal edisi ditarjamahkeun tina Father's Heart Bible™. Ukuran 6 x 9 inci, sampul lemes jeung sampul teuas, dicitak warna. Hiji kado, hiji pangeling-ngeling, hiji warisan.
Pikeun unggal kulawarga jeung jamaah Sunda di Jawa Barat, di Banten, di sakuliah Indonesia jeung di mancanagara — supaya maranehna ngadangu sora Rama dina basa sorangan.
Tampi Rama. Dangukeun sora-Na. Manah-Na mihak ka anjeun.

faq.q: Is the Sundanese edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Sundanese, 1132 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Sundanese edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from Father's Heart Bible™. Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Sundanese edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice™ Color.

In Divine Voice™ Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Sundanese text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Sundanese Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/su.
